stage: tools/tasktracker.py validate crashes on the current tracker: blocker shape
defect: validate() reads node['blocker'].get('reason') and node['blocker'].get('release_when') for every blocked node, but 14 nodes carry blocker as a plain STRING, among them the live STUDIO/AI-12/CODEX-UI child and several progress_2026_10_08 blocks; the validator therefore raises AttributeError before checking anything else, and it fails the same way on origin/main, so it is not caused by my records
fix: the patch accepts both shapes: a dictionary blocker still has to name both reason and release_when, while a plain sentence only has to be non-empty. The same two lines that read activity.state and condition.state through .get are made shape-tolerant for the same reason
